senses.gloss: contradiction, the denial by one set of witnesses of the deposits of the preceding set; counterevidence (contrad. to הֲזָמָה), rejection of evidence owing to counterevidence.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 3b">B. Mets. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>ישנן בה׳ וכ׳</he> are subject to rejection through counterevidence or proof of alibi.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 3b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>אינו בה׳ וכ׳</he> (the debtor’s own admission) cannot be upset by counterevidence &c.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 73b:14">B. Kam. 73ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ה׳ תהלת הזמה וכ׳</he> counterevidence is a preliminary procedure to be finished by proving an alibi, i.e. both are one continued process of law; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 94a:15">B. Kam. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ דהדר</he> (sub. <cite ref="B00748"><he>בישרא</he></cite>) a deterioration which can be raplaced (by good food), <he>ה׳ דלא הדר</he> which cannot be replaced (e.g. a fracture).
